subject.title: Session Routing Bugs: CLI routing to wrong session, WeChat ID inconsistency, and session deadlock from message flooding

question: How should #88204 be split, and which session/channel semantics should core own versus channel/plugin/runtime owners?
rationale: The remaining work spans TUI defaults, gateway session identity, WeChat routing, cron/subagent delivery, and activity-list semantics, so automation cannot safely choose one owner boundary or product behavior.

options.title: Split into focused issues
options.body: Keep #88204 open only as the umbrella until focused TUI, WeChat routing, flood isolation, and #51028 activity-tracking follow-ups are linked.

options.title: Block on live repro first
options.body: Keep the umbrella as-is and require a current-main WeChat/deadlock reproduction before deciding any code split.

options.title: Close activity-only portion
options.body: Treat #51028 as canonical only for list ordering while leaving new focused issues for the other three behaviors.

recommendation.title: Split into focused issues
recommendation.body: Keep #88204 open only as the umbrella until focused TUI, WeChat routing, flood isolation, and #51028 activity-tracking follow-ups are linked.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the visible merger on recent TUI session work and the best listed person for deciding the cross-surface product split.
